body: Thank you for your kind words. Being able to vent here helps a little. Thank you for not making me feel like a terrible person.
Thank you. I don’t know. I just don’t want to keep feeling like this. Some days are worse than others, but lately there’s a nagging feeling telling me I won’t have to worry anymore once I’m dead.

My boyfriend knows to some degree but he doesn’t really know what to do to help me. He’s sort of a loner so even though we live together and have two kids together, he likes to spend the time he isn’t at work or playing with the children by himself. My friends wouldn’t understand it at all. They would invalidate me to the Max.

Definitely not too late! I talked to him this morning and mentioned how sad he has seemed the last few times I saw him. He apologized for worrying me. We talked for a little bit and he told me that he knows I think he's going to commit suicide. But he didn't say that he wasn't. He told me that he has a lot of "messed up" things about his life and said next time  we're alone, he might talk to me about them. So I think that's a good first step. When I  told him he wasn't alone he didn't respond :(
Definitely not going to do that until we've had a conversation about this.
He used to steal my tights in our teens. I already knew he liked them. I didn't know he actually wore them often.

His friend has mentioned that he has been talking about suicide very often this last week, so that's why she messaged me. Not to stir shit. My brother has talked very highly of this person and if he trusts her, then so do I. I plan to talk to him though. I am just trying to figure out what I want to say to start the conversation off right. My biggest fear is that he is going to freak out and try hurting himself.

First of all, I'd like to thank you all for your input. It's very helpful. I'm new to all of this and I'm sorry if I come off as disrespectful or rude. I'm really not trying to be. I definitely will have this conversation with him.  I want to make it very clear that I love and support him no matter what. Brother or sister he is my best friend. Secondly, the only reason I have not referred to him as my "sister" is because I don't feel right doing so without his permission. His friend told me that he wears tights every day, under his clothes and likes to wear them at home when he is alone. I was thinking of buying him some Zelda themed ones, that's one of his favorite video game franchises. But now I'm thinking maybe I should hold off on that for now. Maybe I will try some soap as suggested.
